Package dev.salusa.crypto

Class XAes256GcmKeySpec

java.lang.Object
dev.salusa.crypto.XAes256GcmKeySpec
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Key, KeySpec, SecretKey, Destroyable
public final class XAes256GcmKeySpec extends Object implements SecretKey, KeySpec
A SecretKey for use with XAes256Gcm in a way similar to a SecretKeySpec.

You should reuse instances of this class as much as possible as it performs a somewhat expensive key-derivation step at creation time. By reusing instances, you only pay that cost once per key.

This class is immutable and thread-safe.

Since:
1.1.0
